[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابماتسكنأوائلهمنالأفعالالمزيدة)#755/r1] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | The verb اتخذ in the verse belongs to افتعل: this pattern begins with tāʾ after a connecting hamza and follows the same inflectional scheme as انفعل.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابماتسكنأوائلهمنالأفعالالمزيدة)#755/r10] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | افعولت adds a doubled wāw in the third position and also follows استفعل in inflection, as in اعلوط and اعلوطت.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابماتسكنأوائلهمنالأفعالالمزيدة)#755/r11] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | The forms هرقت and أهرقت reflect substitution or compensation for the hamza; in أهرقت the hāʾ compensates for deleting and vowellessing the root عين.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابماتسكنأوائلهمنالأفعالالمزيدة)#755/r12] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | أَسْطَاعَ similarly uses sīn as a compensatory added consonant, since sīn is among the verbal augment letters; the added hāʾ is also licensed in verbs.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابماتسكنأوائلهمنالأفعالالمزيدة)#755/r2] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | انفعل begins with nūn and requires a connecting alif at the start; its present and participial forms follow ينفعل, منفعل, and منفعل with the stated participle vowel.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابماتسكنأوائلهمنالأفعالالمزيدة)#755/r3] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | The nūn prefix occurs only in انفعل; the tāʾ in second position belongs only to افتعل when the preceding consonant is part of the root.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابماتسكنأوائلهمنالأفعالالمزيدة)#755/r4] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | استفعل starts with sīn and tāʾ and takes a connecting alif; its present form is يستفعل.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابماتسكنأوائلهمنالأفعالالمزيدة)#755/r5] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | Across augmented patterns, the present vowel before the final consonant usually distinguishes active and passive forms; patterns with open vowels such as يتفاعل and يتفعل retain them.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابماتسكنأوائلهمنالأفعالالمزيدة)#755/r6] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | Forms with a connecting alif generally follow فعِل in movement and sukūn, except that the third consonant is ḍamma; examples include استفعل and افتعل.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابماتسكنأوائلهمنالأفعالالمزيدة)#755/r7] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | The pattern افعاللت parallels استفعل in inflection, but idghām causes its first lām to be vowelless; its alif changes to wāw when deriving the cited form because of the preceding ḍamma.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابماتسكنأوائلهمنالأفعالالمزيدة)#755/r8] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | افعللت parallels افتعل in conjugation and is likewise affected by idghām; احمررت illustrates the only position where a doubled lām follows a vowelled consonant.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابماتسكنأوائلهمنالأفعالالمزيدة)#755/r9] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | افعوعلت inserts wāw between two عين consonants and follows استفعل in conjugation; the separation occurs only in this pattern.
